Style: Hyperrealistic corporate photography with cinematic realism. In a bright, modern conference room, a young East Asian woman in her early 30s stands beside a large wall-mounted projection screen during a professional presentation. She has fair skin, a slim build, dark brown to black hair tied into a neat low updo, softly groomed brows, natural eye makeup, subtle blush, and muted rose lipstick. She wears a fitted matte white business suit with a blazer and trousers over a white top, along with small stud earrings, a wristwatch, and a ring. Her posture is upright and confident; she faces the seated audience in profile, looks toward the projected slide, and raises her right index finger to point at the technical diagram. Her mouth is slightly open as if explaining a concept, giving her expression a focused, composed, and professional quality. The room uses cool white office lighting, smooth gray walls, dark wood flooring, and a clean minimalist design. In the foreground, several attendees are visible mostly from behind and out of focus, seated around a long wooden conference table with laptops, papers, a smartphone, a notebook, and a clear glass water bottle with a metal cap. Dark upholstered office chairs frame the lower edge of the image, reinforcing the perspective of an active meeting.

The center-right projection screen dominates the scene and displays a dark navy-to-black presentation slide with thin light-gray borders, structured grid dividers, small outline icons, arrows, and diagram boxes. The slide uses pale blue-gray and white typography, with section headers in brighter blue-gray. At the upper left of the slide, the main title reads "扩散模型核心技术详解". Beneath it, a vertical sidebar lists five numbered sections in square outlined number boxes: "1. 扩散模型概述", "2. 核心架构", "3. 训练过程", "4. 推理过程", and "5. 应用与优势". To the right of this list, the first large panel title reads "1. 扩散模型概述". Its full body text as follows: "扩散模型（Diffusion Model）是一种基于随机微分方程的生成模型，通过逐步向数据添加噪声（前向扩散），再从纯噪声中逐步去噪生成高质量数据（反向扩散）。其核心思想是学习数据分布的渐近路径。" Inside the same overview panel, three small flat line icons appear in light gray-blue: a waveform icon beside the label "概率密度", a bell-curve distribution icon beside "高斯噪声", and a circular refresh-arrow icon beside "迭代优化".

Below the overview, the second major panel is titled "2. 核心架构". Its full body text as follows: "扩散模型由前向过程（加噪）和反向过程（去噪）组成，通常包含一个神经网络作为去噪网络（Denoising U-Net）。" On the left side of this panel, a vertical sequence of four rounded-square icon frames illustrates the process: a noisy static-like texture, a more defined latent pattern, another intermediate textured patch, and a clean grayscale image resembling mountains or terrain. Light gray arrows connect these icon boxes vertically downward. A thin bracket line extends from the sequence toward the middle of the panel, where a neural-network block is drawn as a rectangular container filled with multiple vertical columns of small circular nodes connected by thin gray lines. Under this diagram, the caption reads "去噪网络（Denoising U-Net）". On the right side of the architecture panel, two compact legend boxes use small colored dot markers. The first reads "x_t：时刻 t 的噪声数据分布", and the second reads "θ_φ：去噪网络参数".

Further down, the third panel is titled "3. 训练过程". Its full body text as follows: "在训练阶段，我们模拟前向扩散过程，并让去噪网络预测原始数据或噪声。目标是最小化预测误差。" Four numbered circular step markers run vertically on the left, each aligned with a small rounded image thumbnail showing progressively clearer mountain imagery. The labels next to them read "T", "t", "t-1", and "0". The first thumbnail is heavily noisy, the second contains strong random noise, the third shows partially resolved mountain forms, and the fourth is a clearer grayscale mountain scene. Curved and straight arrows between the thumbnails show iterative denoising over time. Near the bottom center of this training-process panel, a small rectangular formula box contains "ℒ = E_{q(x_T|x_0)} E_{ε∼N(0,I)} || ε - ε_θ(x_t,t,x_0) ||_2^2". A small legend beside it reads "ε_θ：去噪网络预测的噪声".

At the lower left of the slide, the fourth panel is titled "4. 推理过程". Its full body text as follows: "在推理阶段，我们从纯噪声开始，根据 learned 的条件逐步去噪，得到最终生成结果。" Four rounded-square thumbnails below the text again show a noisy image evolving into a clearer mountain landscape. Arrows between the thumbnails indicate step-by-step generation from right to left visually, with a final arrow pointing to the last clear image. The thumbnails have light gray borders and dark interiors, matching the slide’s technical visual language.

To the lower right, the fifth panel is titled "5. 应用与优势". Its full body text as follows: "扩散模型在图像生成、视频生成、3D 内容、科学计算等领域表现出色，具有高质量生成和良好可控性的优势。" Along the bottom of this panel are four rounded rectangular application cards with small illustrative images: a realistic landscape or architectural scene, a stylized fantasy city or cinematic environment, a blue-toned technical network or molecular visualization, and a dark 3D object or mechanical form. Under these cards, four light-gray checkmark icons introduce advantage statements reading "高质量生成", "细节丰富", "可控性强", and "泛化能力好".

Near the bottom-right corner of the slide, a separate bordered summary card contains the heading "总结". Its full body text as follows: "扩散模型通过建模数据的渐进变化路径，实现了从噪声到数据的生成过程，是当前生成式 AI 中最具影响力的模型之一。" The entire slide is framed by a thin rectangular border, divided into clean modular cells, and uses consistent thin-line iconography, arrows, and diagrammatic spacing. The presenter’s raised hand points directly toward the architectural section, making that part of the slide the visual focus. The overall atmosphere is polished, intelligent, and businesslike, combining a realistic workplace setting with a highly legible technical educational presentation.
